claimRewards().details: Accumulates and claims all pending rewards for the caller.

returns.rewardsList: List of reward addresses   claimedAmounts List of claimed amounts. Follows rewardsList items order

configureReward((address,uint256,uint256.details: Configures reward tokens for USDC liquidity incentives

getAllUserRewards(address).details: Returns a list of all reward amounts for each reward token for a user, including already accrued and unrealized rewards.

returns.pendingAmounts: The list of the unrealized, non-accrued amounts of rewards
returns.unclaimedAmounts: The list of the accrued yet unclaimed amounts of rewards

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

relayVaultAction(address,uint256,bool).details: Updates reward index and accrues (but does not claim) rewards for user. This can only be called by the USDC vault when users have deposited/withdrawn USDC from the lending pool.

params.assetAmount: The user's current amount change in USDC tokens.
params.isDeposit: If boolean is true, action is deposit. If false, action is withdrawal
params.user: Address that deposited to or withdrew from lending pool.

removeReward(address).details: Removes reward token from _rewardsList for USDC liquidity incentives

params.rewardToRemove: Address of the token to be removed

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

setVaults(address,address).details: The USDC vault coordinates with this contract whenever a user deposits or withdraws USDC from the lending pool.

params._rewardsVault: The address that distributes the rewards

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.
